Callout.Name: Contraband with a Visitor
Callout.Message: Visitor found with contraband at the gate.
Callout.Advisory: Visitor detained, item recovered, no violence.

Script.Line: It was in the pram, under the blanket.
She says she did not know it was in there. They all say that.
It is bagged and it is in the office. Do not touch it without gloves.

Lines.Approach: They found it at the gate and she is still in the search room. She is not saying who it was for.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
